references.text: Jesus healed many who suffered from various diseases and drove out many demons, demonstrating his healing power and authority over evil, similar to what is described in Mark 3:10.
People asked to touch Jesus' cloak for healing, showing their faith in his healing power, parallel to the event in Mark 3:10.
The whole crowd tried to touch Jesus because power went out from him and healed everyone, reflecting the situation in Mark 3:10 where people flocked to Jesus for healing.
